text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Trainy-Peeey!! Isn't this chocolate so 
good!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It's Valentine's Day. A chance to express 
gratitude and love to those who take care 
of you and mean so much to you—"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
It's red and looks totally classy!? And 
it's berry-flavored! So cute!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios was no exception... She 
wanted to give Daiichi Ruby some 
chocolate, so they were picking some out 
together.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
It's got so much stuff packed into it! 
Being able to eat a lot makes you happier, 
right?
choice_data_list:
I guess I'm more of a 
quality-over-quantity kind of guy, though.

I guess I'm more of a 
quality-over-quantity kind of person, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Totally!! Let's ask a pro!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Um, excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm okay— H-Helios-san! Whoa, I'm 
such a huge fan...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Fo' real? Thx a bunch! You free right now?

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text: How can I help you!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I wanna give chocolates to my crush! And 
she's, like, super high-class and elegant~

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I've always just been on the receiving 
end! I don't really get how this stuff 
works. S-So... umm.
choice_data_list:
What kind of chocolate do you want to 
give?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Or that!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Pwease give me choco that'll make my crush 
wuv me!

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Understood! I will enthusiastically make 
the selection!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Thanks a bunch!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Heheh♪ I can't wait for Valentine's!
choice_data_list: I'm glad you were able to buy it.
I'm glad you were able to buy it.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if Milady's gonna fall in love 
with my style? Gotta make it happen--!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A simple question suddenly comes to mind. 
If Daiichi Ruby were to fall for him, what 
would Daitaku Helios actually want to do?
choice_data_list:
How does Helios want things to be with 
Ruby?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean "what happens"? Won't it 
just stay the same?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
A "shukipi" is, like, someone you wuv 
tons, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
When you wuv something, it's like, 
mega-lolz, right??

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I'm always laughing like crazy with you, 
my pals, and Palmer-chin, right? That's 
what it's all about!"
choice_data_list:
I heard she'll show me her smile if we 
ever end up liking each other...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: So true☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I know Ojo and I are total opposites. 
Trust me, I get it!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ojo, you always say that's "wrong." But 
the opposite isn't wrong, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I bet I can smile with that exact same 
face. Ab-so-lute-ly!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios passionately explains her 
case. If she can just get the chocolate 
accepted, it'll surely be a step toward 
closing the distance between them.
choice_data_list: I hope they like the chocolates.
I hope they like the chocolates!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Right? ♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And then came Valentine's Day. While 
wishing Daitaku Helios the best of luck, I 
was getting some work done, but—"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I got dumped--!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'm going from pien to paon, roaring in 
tears and so salt-tastic~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I just went to give Ruby some 
chocolate, but...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
“—It pains me greatly to say this, but I 
cannot accept.”

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Eeeeehhhh!? Why!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, you don't like chocolate? No sweets? 
In that case—"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Let's hype up the Sprint division 
together." That is what you told me just 
moments ago, correct?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, you came over here too, Lady☆ 
Maybe we could start a Heli-Ruby Channel♪"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I did not come; I have fallen.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Either way, I will wager my life to 
deliver results in every single race I run 
from now on.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I cannot accept your 
feelings... No, I will not accept them.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Please... I hope for your understanding.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "I got toootally rejected!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I don't think I've been dumped or 
anything, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Didn't Ruby, like, turn down getting hyped 
together?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
No way-! Nobody hates getting hyped up, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"...I think maybe I understand how Ruby 
feels, just a little."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I mean, look, I come from a pretty 
prestigious family of Umamusume, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yet they didn't go for the Classic Triple 
Crown or the traditional royal road races.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's something I decided for myself, but 
even so, I still find myself thinking 
about it, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if it would've been nice if I 
could've lived up to everyone's 
expectations, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah! But right now, I have absolutely no 
regrets, though!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
“But... maybe Ruby's situation isn't like 
that. Maybe it's not a forward-looking 
decision.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Still, if she's resolved to take that 
path, she must be prepared for what lies 
ahead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So maybe it was a declaration that they 
have no intention of having fun. Well, 
it's all just speculation, though.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...In other words, Palmer-chin. I'm...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: So you're saying there's still a chance!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah! There's totally a chance, right?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah!! There's a chaaaance!
choice_data_list:
...Are you properly following what Palmer 
is saying?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Dunno what's up with Ruby, but you 
can't hype her up, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Then all ya gotta do is run with me☆ I'm 
crazy good at hyping folks up, ya know!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Btw, wanna party now? Wanna chocolate 
party?? It's Valentine's after all!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "I got some for Trainer-Palmer too!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"That's a trade secret, or like, ninja 
arts, ya know!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Tbh, I only snuck in there yesterday, 
though☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Helios!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Totes, I got one ready too! I picked out 
the very best one!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: As expected! Now we can party, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Nothing beats besties and my 
Trainer-poyo~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we held a little chocolate party 
with a fully recovered Daitaku Helios and 
Mejiro Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nice! It is Valentine's Day, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayyy~! Then right away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though it's called a party, it's likely 
more like an exchange gathering.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Heading into our third year walking 
alongside Daitaku Helios, both Mejiro 
Palmer and I were still naive enough to 
indulge in such wishful thinking—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—Hell yeah!! I'm gonna give it everything 
I've got!!

text_block_list.name: Helios's Friend A
text_block_list.text: Bring it ooon!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh, Helios... what's this...?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
A choco-party, right? A 'Super Gigantic 
Chocolate Fountain Party'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Daitaku Helios had prepared was... a 
giant chocolate fountain that almost 
seemed tall enough to reach the gymnasium 
ceiling!
choice_data_list: Wait, do you have permission for this...!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: The Chairwoman is—!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Engaging from the landing is fine, and 
using the ladder is fine too!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Seriously, no swimming!! Don't waste food!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I've got special chocolates for 
Palm-chin and Trai-pi!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, could that be hanging from the 
ceiling...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yup! That ridiculously huge heart!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at where Daitaku Helios pointed... 
a colossal heart was hanging from the 
ceiling. Upon closer inspection, an 
addressee was written on the wrapping 
paper.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wh-wha...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "Will you accept... my love??"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Guh!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Twinkle, twinkle, twinkle...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Trainer!
choice_data_list: Yeah, thank you for the food!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: —I'm... so full...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Nhihihi☆ Pure bliss, ain't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Fufu... That's right, I'm so happy!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I'm so hap-pyyy☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a Valentine's Day filled to 
bursting with all the love Daitaku Helios 
had to give.
